title: Isandro and the Regiment
author: Juniper Vasquez
blurb: Felix Eastwick, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
